MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The SSD feels relevant to my computer upkeep and upgrade interests, provided my machine supports a 2.5-inch SATA drive.",
    "The short Ethernet cables fit my recent USB Ethernet adapter and cable-organizing purchases, provided one foot reaches the connections I need to tidy."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Streaming players do not help with my current computer maintenance and networking tasks; my older Raspberry Pi entertainment project does not mean I need a streaming device now.",
    "The Echo devices and smart plug assume an interest in voice control and home automation that my purchases do not show.",
    "The HDMI cable repeats something I already have without a clear need for a longer cable or replacement."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying electronics seems to have been treated as a reason to suggest broadly popular electronic devices, even when they serve unrelated purposes.",
    "My older entertainment-related purchases seem to carry too much weight compared with my more recent computer and networking work."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent adapter, Ethernet cables, headphone mount and duster point toward maintaining and organizing an existing computer setup.",
    "Accessories are useful when they solve a specific remaining problem; owning a similar cable can mean that need is already covered.",
    "Physical compatibility matters to my choices: the SSD must fit my computer, and short cables must reach their intended connections."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognize my computer setup interests but stretch them into streaming and smart-home needs I do not currently have."
}
